verdict.rationale: No evidence pack items address data retention policies, data deletion controls, or privacy/compliance settings for call recordings, transcripts, or memory data. This axis clearly applies to an enterprise voice AI platform handling call data, but nothing in the evidence documents retention periods, deletion APIs, or GDPR/CCPA-style data controls. Missing for 10: retention policy docs, data deletion API/endpoint, compliance certifications, memory/data purge mechanism.
